metadata.defaultTitle: Hyvän Tuulen Sauna | Floating sauna and experiences in Helsinki
metadata.defaultDescription: Experience an authentic wood-fired sauna and the refreshing sea in the Eastern Helsinki archipelago. Public sauna sessions and private sauna boat cruises in Aurinkolahti, Kalkkihiekantori.

footer.tagline: Authentic sauna experience in Helsinki — sauna boats in summer, private sauna all year round.
